title: The Placebo Effect: How Belief Changes the Body
question: How can an inert sugar pill relieve real symptoms — and what does that reveal about the link between mind and body?
summary: Placebos can relieve pain, nausea, and anxiety through expectation, conditioning, and the ritual of care. This exploration separates genuine placebo effects from statistical illusions, examines the brain chemistry behind them, and considers open-label placebos and their dark twin, the nocebo.
